name: Kusui Yachitaka
source:
An utterly hopeless piece of trash.

The protagonist of this story. A hopeless man whose hobbies are gambling, drinking, smoking, and women. He's trying to increase his number of sex friends to stabilize his life.
He meets Sayuki by chance and begins to plan how to turn her into a woman who is convenient for him. He has a personality that can be utterly ruthless depending on the situation, and seems to be aware that he is the scum of society.
